name: resume-tailor
description: Turn your real work into targeted, one-page LaTeX resumes. Imports your existing resume and mines your repos into verified accomplishment notes, then tailors a resume per job description (multi-JD batches in parallel), writes matching cover letters and application-question answers in your voice, checks keyword coverage deterministically, tracks every application in an interactive local dashboard, and supports drop-in custom resume templates. Every bullet traces to real work - nothing is invented.
